rows: I heard you. Now ask me.
Brawling. You want a fight, or you want a result?
A risk. Yes. I have heard of them.
The people came for something. I know what it is. Really?
The short of it: I do not need you to speak for me.
I am not hired muscle. I have never been, and I am not starting tonight.
Look, then. That is the stance. Nobody is holding me up.
Technique. Show it. Demonstrate it. I will wait.
Strikes are part of it. Silence is more part of it.
A risk is yours to take. I am not going to take it for you.
A stall. Right. You will need more than that.
The people deserve better than someone talking on my behalf. I will speak for myself.
You say you are the one who matters here. I will let the silence answer that.
You are proud of your {strength}. Fine. I do not need to hear about it again.
I have noted your {strength}. Now do something with it.
Calm. Noted. Enough. So did I. Nothing to say.
I could say more. I am not going to.
One. Only one. Keep me down, and then you can talk.
On the mat, I decide when we move. Not you.
Grounded or standing, I am still here. Waiting.
Keep looking at me. Then say something.
Still nothing from you. I am still waiting.
I will fight this match on my own terms, and I will not say much about it.
Simple plan. Nothing else. Nobody speaks for me in the ring.
Whatever happens, you will know exactly where I stood.
Nothing is decided. I am still waiting.
I have one challenge left. You'll see it when the bell goes.
